name: Editing commands
description: Editing commands and keys in every note: bold, italics, highlight, strikethrough, code, math and comment, ⌘K for a link, ⌘L for a task, ⌘D to delete a line, headings, lists, quotes, and callouts, tables, footnotes, code and math blocks, and Add photo (on a phone, from its photos or camera). Right-click in a note for them, the clipboard and searching what's selected.
